_doc: Write scopes per role. Read by tools/agent-anchor.mjs and tools/write-guard.mjs. A session's role comes from an exact line 'ICM-ROLE: <role>' anywhere in its first message (icm/agents/boot-prompts.md). No marker = the Lead (unrestricted). Globs: '**' = any depth, '*' = one path segment. appendOnly files may only grow at the end. Writer of this file: the Lead.
